problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target. Each input has exactly one solution.
problems.approach: Store each number in a HashMap as we scan. For every element, check if (target - num) already exists in the map. Single pass — O(n) time, O(n) space.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.description: Given an array prices where prices[i] is the price on day i, return the maximum profit you can achieve. You can only buy once and sell once.
problems.approach: Track the minimum price seen so far. At each step compute profit = current - minPrice. Update max profit if it's higher. One pass — O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.description: Find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) that has the largest sum and return its sum.
problems.approach: Kadane's Algorithm — at each element decide: extend the existing subarray OR start fresh from here (whichever is larger). Track global max. O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description: Return true if any value appears at least twice in the array. Return false if every element is distinct.
problems.approach: Use a HashSet to track seen numbers. If the current number is already in the set, return true immediately. O(n) time, O(n) space.

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.description: Return an array answer such that answer[i] equals the product of all elements except nums[i]. Must run in O(n) without using division.
problems.approach: Two passes without division. Left pass: result[i] holds product of everything to the left. Right pass: multiply by the running product from the right. O(n) time, O(1) extra space.
